title: DecisionTracker for control decisions (TS + Rust); CTL-S7 check follows the spec (intent COMMIT before the first engage)
notes: Follow-ups of P1-09. (1) DecisionTracker (TS trust.ts, Rust trust.rs) tracks profile control: CTL-T1..T5 via tdControlFormatErrors + own tick order (no go-back, one move per tick, HOLD may repeat), CTL-S1..S7 via new ControlSafety state machine shared with fep0005 safetyErrors; new field tick; forward on a valid control COMMIT (acted list = moving ticks). Python has no DecisionTracker. Tracker equals the fep-0005 decision-log vectors (errors exactly on reject, forwarded ticks = moving_ticks). (2) CTL-S7: fep-0005 check in Python/TS/Rust refuses an intent COMMIT while the last control decision of the session shows a non-engaged control (engagement 0, not_engaged/disengaged reason, stop latched until a higher engagement); before, only after a stop. No vector flipped. New E20 (reject) and E21 (accept): fep-0005 44 vectors. 7.4.5 notes are informative (no MUST): no check. Parity 281/281; fuzz seeds 1-6 --n 30 44,556 mutants (fep-0005 7,920). pytest 801 passed/10 skipped (+1 new test after), npm test 38, cargo test pass, thumbv7em build pass.
